title: A 3840 by 2560 file on XAVC HS 4K and on XAVC S 4K at 23.98p, 25p and 29.97p: the union of ogfile2560_hs_v1 and ogfile2560_s_v1; the MP4 headers (tkhd, stsd, Sony's PROF) say 3840x2560
